title: You’re accepted.
body:
Dear future student,

In this imagined story, you’ve been accepted to Middlebury College. A new chapter is waiting. Pack your bag; we’ll meet you in Vermont.

endTitle: You’ve reached the end of D1.
endBody: A greeter is waiting on the platform. Meeting them and creating your character come next, in a later demo.

rideSteps.title: 1 of 3 · Leaving home
rideSteps.caption: Your bag is by your feet. Beyond the window, the departure platform slips away. The wheels settle into a steady rhythm.

rideSteps.title: 2 of 3 · Into Vermont
rideSteps.caption: The view opens to green hills and autumn trees. You’re riding into Vermont now. There’s time to watch the fields go by.

rideSteps.title: 3 of 3 · Almost there
rideSteps.caption: Roofs replace the open fields. The train slows; a platform comes into view. Gather your bag — Middlebury station is next.
